title: YES BOONE SHARES HIGHLY-ANTICIPATED NEW SINGLE ‘NOSEBLEEDS’
summary: MARKS HIS FIRST RELEASE WITH WARNER MUSIC AUSTRALIA AND WARNER RECORDS US. . .
body_markdown:
##### MARKS HIS FIRST RELEASE WITH WARNER MUSIC AUSTRALIA AND WARNER RECORDS US


Today, multi-talented Sydney producer[Yes Boone](https://www.instagram.com/yesboone) has unveiled his stadium-sized new single ‘ ***Nosebleeds*** ’. The pulsating track takes inspiration from French house, mixing it with an introspective and darker flair drawn from British post-punk stalwarts like **The Cure** and **The Smiths** . With Yes Boone taking centre-stage by adding his vocals to the mix, ‘ ***Nosebleeds*** ’ is a bold first taste of what’s to come following his recent signing with **Warner Music Australia** and **Warner Records US.** Listen[HERE](https://drop.cobrand.com/d/YesBooneAU/nb) .


Of the song, Yes Boone shares, *“Nosebleeds is about the infatuation you feel early on in a relationship, and all the dramatic uncertainty that comes with it. There’s something theatrical about it that I’m trying to capture with the music. I wrote it during a period in London and Paris, which feels like the respective homes of the vocal style and the production choices. It took a little while to find my voice, to sing on my own tracks, and to put my own words to the music for the first time”.*


Last month at Warner Music Australia’s annual Listen Up Showcase, it was announced to industry guests that Yes Boone had signed with Warner Music Australia in partnership with Warner Records US. To celebrate the announcement, Yes Boone performed a surprise DJ set, where he debuted the new release.


On signing with Warner Music Australia / Warner Records US, Yes Boone shares, *“* *The new music is a new and bold step for me, and it’s been amazing to have the Australian and International Warner Music teams come onto the project and immediately understand, and amplify what I’m working towards”.*


**Dan Rosen** , President of Warner Music Australasia and Southeast Asia says, *“Yes Boone is a brilliant artist and producer at the vanguard of Australia’s electronic music scene. I am thrilled to welcome him to the Warner Music family and to launch this next phase of his career and global trajectory.”*


From falling in love with the sounds that global producers Avicii and Skrillex were pioneering, Yes Boone **** crafted in solitude for a year, before releasing music on SoundCloud, and making DJ mixes. Winning a DJ mix competition during his final year of high school put him on the map locally, while joining a band after high school gave him an insight into what it really took to take the leap as an artist.


Yes Boone wields the detail-orientated nature of a studious producer, while exuding the charisma of some of history’s most iconic frontmen. **Streamed over 11 million times,** he received recognition from the likes of **triple j** and **BBC Radio** , achieving Top 10 radio airplay with his breakout hit, ‘[All I Really Want](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b14kdOtAcYE&pp=ygUbeWVzIGJvb25lIGFsbCBpIHJlYWxseSB3YW50) ’. In the live arena, he’s shared the stage with global stars like **Diplo, Dom Dolla,** and **Martin Garrix.** His 2025 debut EP ***Best I’ve Found*** ** saw him become a name to watch. Now, he’s embarking on an exciting new era. As he heads towards the end of the year, he will be performing across Australia as part of the 2026 **Spilt Milk** line-up, and performing at Wollongong’s **Yours and Owls Festival** .


Stay tuned for more from the magnetic maestro. The best is still to come.
